description: Fluted cast base, swept arm, peaked shade and eight opal lens ribs.
Open basket with vented slats, liner, rolled rim and bolted ring foot.
Window-mounted air conditioner with return louvers, fan guard and bent brackets.
Twin fan condenser with louvered coils, guards and independent impellers.
Stainless front-loader with rotating perforated drum, fascia, latch and seals.
Wall-mounted chrome globe, clear sleeve and spiral painted rotor.
Articulated task lamp, padded hand rest, polish rack and brush cup.
Rounded pink base, stone worktop, working-height drawer pedestal and chrome pulls.
Curved plate-glass case with walnut panels, trays, croissants, rolls and ring doughnuts.
Two-door refrigerated cabinet with sliding glass, lit shelf rails and individually stocked glass bottles.
Foot-mounted end-suction pump, cooling fins, coupling guard and flanged discharge. Internal engineering is inferred.
Boardwalk life ring with four canvas bands, grab line, rope hooks and bolted timber post.
Exterior meter box with glass dial, service conduit, clamps and weather head.
Two-tier oak window table with jacketed books, page blocks and face-out paperback stands.
Twin-group espresso maker with steam wands, drip tray, gauge, cup rail and porcelain cups.
Timber planting crate with individual stems, foliage and yellow or ochre flower heads.
Forking avenue sycamore with a lightly pruned crown and layered sprays of photographed leaves.
Scarred leaning trunk, persistent dry skirt and folded, tapered individual leaflets.
